maria: Heads-up: final pass on tri-mode landing copy today. Need hero lines + primary CTAs.
tony: Hosteds should lead with time-to-value: 'Ship LLM features in hours, not weeks.' CTA: 'Get an API key'.
elaine: Dedicated: emphasize predictability and cost controls: 'Reserved capacity with SLA-backed throughput.' CTA: 'Talk to sales'.
oscar: Private: focus security and compliance: 'Deploy in your VPC. Keep full control.' CTA: 'Request on-prem info'.
maria: We'll include a small ribbon for webinar signup: 'Live: Serving LLMs at scale' -> 'Reserve seat'.
tony: Add conservative benchmark line under Hosted: 'Average token latency ~80ms for short chats (internal)'. Confirm with eng before publish.
elaine: Routing note: signup form should capture 'deployment_interest' and 'monthly_tokens' hidden fields; flag Private leads for compliance follow-up.
product-bot: Reminder: content freeze today 5pm PT.
maria: I'll consolidate edits into a single doc and drop final copy here by 3pm.
